scenario_description:
Objective: Make Monday’s Seattle-to-Portland return more workable for reviewing courier notes while the confirmed coach trip still serves the handoff.
Emerging Need: A no-fee table seat is not worth pursuing until the review packet, paid reservation, train details, and seat-inventory bulletin line up.
Decision Context: The useful choice depends on joining the notices with stored packet details and Cascades table-seat rules that identify when the option matters and when it locks.
Consequence: Timely coordination would add workspace during the ride; missing the chart window simply leaves the ordinary coach seat in place.

parameter.body: The green courier folder will travel with the loan documents tomorrow, and Portland receiving staff expect the courier travel notes on arrival. No authenticity, valuation, or contract review is being added.

parameter.body: One no-fee table seat has opened on Cascades 508 for Monday. Eligible ticketed travelers may submit a seat-change review while the chart is open; existing coach assignments remain valid either way.

parameter.content: Seat chart for Cascades 508 is now locked for tomorrow; any unrequested table seats have returned to day-of counter handling. Existing coach seats remain valid.
